title: Windows ZIP listing still fails through PowerShell stdout
original_report: Valera confirmed that install onec-direct-cli still fails on Windows with an unsafe-path error in Hobbyka Hub 0.4.23.
expected: A valid onec-direct-cli ZIP installs on Windows.
actual: The safe ZIP is rejected while entry names pass through PowerShell stdout.
environment: Windows report from Hobbyka Hub 0.4.23; local deterministic source-level regression on macOS arm64
reproduction: The focused test requires the Windows path to bypass PowerShell stdout and read an explicitly UTF-8 listing file.
failure_signal: The test exits 1 while listArchive still captures PowerShell stdout.
root_cause: Setting Console.OutputEncoding was insufficient in the reporter's Windows PowerShell host; archive entry names still crossed an unreliable text-encoding boundary.
fix_summary: PowerShell writes archive entry names directly to an explicit UTF-8 file, which Node reads with readFileSync; version bumped to 0.4.25.
why_causal: The unsafe stdout encoding boundary is no longer used.

reproduction_files.summary: Regression test requiring file-based UTF-8 transfer.

checks.name: Hub suite
checks.detail: Self-test and all Node tests pass.

limitations: Final end-to-end confirmation must be performed on Valera's Windows machine.
residual_risks: A different Windows-only extraction failure may surface after path validation succeeds.
notes: The onec-direct-cli package is unchanged and its live ZIP remains valid.
